title: agati tomentosa
intro: Agati tomentosa, commonly known as Ashwagandha, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae and is native to India and Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, offering numerous health benefits such as stress relief, anxiety reduction, and improved sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Ashwagandha include its adaptogenic properties, which help the body adapt to stress, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help protect against cell damage and chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of Ashwagandha include withanolides, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often extracted and used in herbal supplements.
